title: Split the bill
source: iPhone Shortcuts users request tip-and-split-among-N-people automations (Automators forum ask that spawned community builds; ShortcutsGallery 'Calculate Tip & Split'). https://talk.automators.fm/t/anyone-have-a-tip-calculator-shortcut-that-splits-bill-between-x-amount-if-people/6725
signature: function splitBill(total, people)  // total: number, people: integer -> number (per person, 2 decimals)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `splitBill(total, people)` that divides `total` evenly among `people` and returns the amount each person pays, rounded to 2 decimal places (as a number). For example splitBill(100, 3) is 33.33.
